entities.summary: Umayyad, a notable figure in the history of Azerbaijan, associated with Arab Conquest and Islamic Azerbaijani States (642–850). Preceded by Mass conversion to Islam transforms the region's religious landscape and Arab forces conquer Azerbaijan and Caucasian Albania. Their legacy influenced Shirvanshah Dynasty — Rise and Shirvanshah.
